author: FogSea
quote: After a decade of Fromsoftware-Games, GTA VI feels like something from the past. Boring, hard handling, you crash your car every 10 seconds into something. It feels like 100 mini games in one. You try to find meaning in it, but the game doesn't tell you anything. Are you playing or just wasting your time? For now it feels like wasting time. Like wasting time with another Assassins Creed game. Its always the same game.

author: FogSea
quote:
I finished the game in 14 hours. What a joke. There are basically only three levels repeated throughout the entire game. After playing Resident Evil 4, I expected something with more depth and progression, but I was honestly shocked by how short and repetitive this felt. The lack of effort put into the world-building is incredibly disappointing. Everything feels rushed, shallow, and unfinished. They even spared a trader character. How funny is this?  

For an 80 EUR game, this is completely unacceptable. I genuinely regret buying it and honestly feel like I deserve a refund. This was the last time they made money from me.
